page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 104 dedicated physical cores and 104 vCPUs, utilizing a single thread per core configuration. The system is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This instance runs on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

Given the dedicated physical core allocation and high vCPU density relative to memory, the ecs.c6t.26xlarge offers a highly dense compute profile. This makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. Suitable workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive web serving, and parallelized CPU compilation tasks.
